BenefitUnlimitedComponent.bdBenefitUnlimitedDescription: Endodontic therapy is limited to once per tooth per lifetime. Retreatment of a previous root canal is limited to once per tooth every 24 months.
Scaling and root planing in same quadrant: limited to once/24 months; Periodontal surgery in same quadrant limited to once/36 months.
Periodicity for Prosthodontics (D5110 - D5214) is once every 5 years.
